N1.s: Hai usato tutti i %lld cutling gratuiti. Continua in Cutling per sbloccarlo e salvare anche questo.
N1.back: You-have used all the 5 cutling free. Continue in Cutling for to-unlock-it and to-save also this-one.
N1.why: Opens with S3's own words; 'anche questo' says the new one gets saved on top of the five, without naming it a second time.

N2.s: Hai usato tutti i %lld cutling gratuiti. Apri Cutling e sbloccalo per salvarne altri.
N2.back: You-have used all the 5 cutling free. Open Cutling and unlock-it for to-save-of-them others.
N2.why: Same opening as N1; 'salvarne altri' is the everyday way to say 'save more of them', like S28's 'salvane quanti vuoi'.

N3.why: Past participle alone as the confirmation; 'ne resta uno' is how an Italian says one is left, masculine to agree with 'cutling'; no final period, like K1; 28 characters.

N4.why: The quota as S29 writes it, so '5 di 5' shows the free places are full without a sentence about it; numbers keep their order, so no positional forms.

N5.why: Same quota words as N4 just before it; 'per salvarlo' makes unlocking the way this item gets saved; 36 characters.

N6.why: The imperative verb used in S15 and M1, alone as a button; 7 characters.

N7.s: Hai usato tutti i %lld cutling gratuiti. Sblocca Cutling per salvare anche questo.
N7.back: You-have used all the 5 cutling free. Unlock Cutling for to-save also this-one.
N7.why: Same opening as N1 and N2; the person can unlock right here, so the second sentence is a direct imperative.

N8.s: Questo cutling ti aspetta: verrà salvato quando apri Cutling e lo sblocchi.
N8.back: This cutling you awaits: it-will-be saved when you-open Cutling and it you-unlock.
N8.why: 'Ti aspetta' is how an Italian says something is kept for you, warmly and without the app saying 'we'; the colon leads to how it gets saved; 77 characters.
